title: 破膝打击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：左、上、左。左击、上段斩后，从左侧以刺击攻击对手膝部。
second_page: 盔甲会保护胸腹，却难完全照顾关节。一可以轻松的击伤敌人的膝盖，削减移动能力。然后猛击敌人的面部。翻到这里，你已经开始练习破膝打击。

en_us.title: Knee Strike
en_us.first_page: Input: Left, Up, Left. Follow a left and overhead strike with a thrust from the left into the opponent's knee.
en_us.second_page: Armor protects the torso more easily than the joints. Injure the knee to impair movement, then smash the opponent in the face.
